goal: Building a free fire tournament app for bangladesh

schema.title: Market and Competitor Analysis
schema.description: Analyze existing Free Fire local tournament apps in Bangladesh to identify feature gaps.

schema.title: UI/UX Wireframes Creation
schema.description: Design user interface screens for registration, match room details, and wallet/prizes.

schema.title: Core App Development
schema.description: Spend dedicated hours coding the frontend and backend of the application.

schema.title: Database and Auth Integration
schema.description: Set up authentication via phone number/Google and real-time database for tournament lobbies.

schema.title: Local Payment Integration
schema.description: Integrate Bangladeshi mobile financial services like bKash, Nagad, and Rocket for entry fees and payouts.

schema.title: Bug Fixing and QA Sessions
schema.description: Conduct thorough testing of match room creation and score submission workflows.

schema.title: Beta Testers Onboarded
schema.description: Recruit local Free Fire players to test tournament matchmaking and custom room ID distribution.

schema.title: Daily Development Streak
schema.description: Maintain consecutive days of writing code or resolving app issues.

schema.title: Google Play Store Submission
schema.description: Prepare app assets, privacy policy, and submit the app for Google Play Store review.
